ArcPlayer.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.
ArcPlayer.name: Arc

ArchmagePlayer.description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
ArchmagePlayer.name: Archmage

ArcticArmourPlayer.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.
ArcticArmourPlayer.name: Arctic Armour

BallLightningPlayer.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.
BallLightningPlayer.name: Ball Lightning

BlasphemyPlayer.description: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
BlasphemyPlayer.name: Blasphemy

BlinkPlayer.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
BlinkPlayer.name: Blink

BlinkReservationPlayer.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
BlinkReservationPlayer.name: Blink

BoneBlastPlayer.description: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.
BoneBlastPlayer.name: Bone Blast

BoneCagePlayer.description: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
BoneCagePlayer.name: Bone Cage

BoneOfferingPlayer.description: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
BoneOfferingPlayer.name: Bone Offering

BonestormPlayer.description: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.
BonestormPlayer.name: Bonestorm

ChargeRegulationPlayer.description: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.
ChargeRegulationPlayer.name: Charge Regulation

ChargedStaffPlayer.description: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
ChargedStaffPlayer.name: Charged Staff

CoilingBoltsPlayer.description: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.
CoilingBoltsPlayer.name: Coiling Bolts

CometPlayer.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.
CometPlayer.name: Comet

ContagionPlayer.description: Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
ContagionPlayer.name: Contagion

ConvalescencePlayer.description: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.
ConvalescencePlayer.name: Convalescence

CorpseCloudPlayer.description: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.
CorpseCloudPlayer.name: Decompose

CracklingPalmPlayer.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
CracklingPalmPlayer.name: Crackling Palm

DarkEffigyPlayer.description: Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.
DarkEffigyPlayer.name: Dark Effigy

DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.description: Fire a Projectile at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a Chaos damage over time Debuff. Fires multiple Projectiles at enemies afflicted by multiple Debuffs, but Projectile count cannot be otherwise modified.
DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.name: Vile Effusion

DespairPlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.
DespairPlayer.name: Despair

DetonateDeadPlayer.description: Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
DetonateDeadPlayer.name: Detonate Dead

DisciplinePlayer.description: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.
DisciplinePlayer.name: Discipline

ElementalConfluxPlayer.description: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.
ElementalConfluxPlayer.name: Elemental Conflux

ElementalWeaknessPlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.
ElementalWeaknessPlayer.name: Elemental Weakness

EmberFusilladePlayer.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.
EmberFusilladePlayer.name: Ember Fusillade

EnfeeblePlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.
EnfeeblePlayer.name: Enfeeble

EssenceDrainPlayer.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.
EssenceDrainPlayer.name: Essence Drain

ExsanguinatePlayer.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.
ExsanguinatePlayer.name: Exsanguinate

EyeOfWinterPlayer.description: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.
EyeOfWinterPlayer.name: Eye of Winter

FallingThunderPlayer.description: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
FallingThunderPlayer.name: Falling Thunder

FeastOfFleshPlayer.description: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.
FeastOfFleshPlayer.name: Feast of Flesh

FireballPlayer.description: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
FireballPlayer.name: Fireball

FireboltPlayer.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.
FireboltPlayer.name: Firebolt

FirestormPlayer.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.
FirestormPlayer.name: Firestorm

FlameWallPlayer.description: Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.
FlameWallPlayer.name: Flame Wall

FlameblastPlayer.description: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channelled for.
FlameblastPlayer.name: Flameblast

FlickerStrikePlayer.description: Teleport to a enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.
FlickerStrikePlayer.name: Flicker Strike

FreezingMarkPlayer.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
FreezingMarkPlayer.name: Freezing Mark

FreezingShardsPlayer.description: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.
FreezingShardsPlayer.name: Freezing Shards

FrostBombPlayer.description: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
FrostBombPlayer.name: Frost Bomb

FrostDartsPlayer.description: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.
FrostDartsPlayer.name: Frost Darts

FrostWallPlayer.description: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.
FrostWallPlayer.name: Frost Wall

FrostboltPlayer.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.
FrostboltPlayer.name: Frostbolt

FrozenLocusPlayer.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.
FrozenLocusPlayer.name: Frozen Locus

FulminationPlayer.description: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.
FulminationPlayer.name: Fulmination

GaleStrikePlayer.description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.
GaleStrikePlayer.name: Wind Blast

GalvanicFieldBuffPlayer.description: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.
GalvanicFieldBuffPlayer.name: Galvanic Field

GatheringStormPlayer.description: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing dashes towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
GatheringStormPlayer.name: Gathering Storm

GhostDancePlayer.description: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.
GhostDancePlayer.name: Ghost Dance

GlacialCascadePlayer.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
GlacialCascadePlayer.name: Glacial Cascade

GrimFeastPlayer.description: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
GrimFeastPlayer.name: Grim Feast

GrimFeastResummonPlayer.description: Consume stored Minion Life to Revive your Minions. Revives as many Minions as possible with total maximum Life equal to or less than the Life stored by Grim Feast, prioritising those with higher maximum Life.
GrimFeastResummonPlayer.name: Grim Resurrection

HandOfChayulaPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.
HandOfChayulaPlayer.name: Hand of Chayula

HeartOfIcePlayer.description: Chills all enemies in your Presence.
HeartOfIcePlayer.name: Heart of Ice

HeraldOfIcePlayer.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.
HeraldOfIcePlayer.name: Herald of Ice

HexblastPlayer.description: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.
HexblastPlayer.name: Hexblast

HisFoulEmergencePlayer.description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
HisFoulEmergencePlayer.name: His Foul Emergence

HisWinnowingFlamePlayer.description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.
HisWinnowingFlamePlayer.name: His Winnowing Flame

IceNovaPlayer.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.
IceNovaPlayer.name: Ice Nova

IceStrikePlayer.description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
IceStrikePlayer.name: Ice Strike

IcestormPlayer.description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
IcestormPlayer.name: Icestorm

ImpurityPlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
ImpurityPlayer.name: Impurity

IncineratePlayer.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
IncineratePlayer.name: Incinerate

KillingPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
KillingPalmPlayer.name: Killing Palm

LightningBoltPlayer.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.
LightningBoltPlayer.name: Lightning Bolt

LightningConduitPlayer.description: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
LightningConduitPlayer.name: Lightning Conduit

LightningWarpPlayer.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.
LightningWarpPlayer.name: Lightning Warp

LingeringIllusionPlayer.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.
LingeringIllusionPlayer.name: Lingering Illusion

LivingBombPlayer.description: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.
LivingBombPlayer.name: Living Bomb

MalicePlayer.description: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.
MalicePlayer.name: Malice

ManaDrainPlayer.description: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.
ManaDrainPlayer.name: Mana Drain

ManaRemnantsPlayer.description: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.
ManaRemnantsPlayer.name: Mana Remnants

ManaTempestPlayer.description: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.
ManaTempestPlayer.name: Mana Tempest

MantraOfDestructionPlayer.description:
Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants
Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
MantraOfDestructionPlayer.name: Mantra of Destruction

MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaBarrierInvocationPlayer.name: Barrier Invocation

MetaCastCurseOnBlockPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastCurseOnBlockPlayer.name: Curse on Block

MetaCastOnCritPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnCritPlayer.name: Cast on Critical

MetaCastOnDodgePlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnDodgePlayer.name: Cast on Dodge

MetaCastOnElementalAilmentPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
MetaCastOnElementalAilmentPlayer.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment

MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.
MetaCastOnMinionDeathPlayer.name: Cast on Minion Death

MetaElementalInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaElementalInvocationPlayer.name: Elemental Invocation

MetaReapersInvocationPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaReapersInvocationPlayer.name: Reaper's Invocation

MetaSpellslingerPlayer.description: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
MetaSpellslingerPlayer.name: Spellslinger

MirrorOfRefractionPlayer.description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
MirrorOfRefractionPlayer.name: Mirror of Refraction

OrbOfStormsPlayer.description: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
OrbOfStormsPlayer.name: Orb of Storms

PainOfferingPlayer.description: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
PainOfferingPlayer.name: Pain Offering

PowerSiphonPlayer.description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.
PowerSiphonPlayer.name: Power Siphon

ProfaneRitualPlayer.description: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.
ProfaneRitualPlayer.name: Profane Ritual

PurityOfFirePlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
PurityOfFirePlayer.name: Purity of Fire

PurityOfIcePlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
PurityOfIcePlayer.name: Purity of Ice

PurityOfLightningPlayer.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
PurityOfLightningPlayer.name: Purity of Lightning

RagingSpiritsPlayer.description: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
RagingSpiritsPlayer.name: Raging Spirits

RaiseZombiePlayer.description: Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.
RaiseZombiePlayer.name: Raise Zombie

RavenousSwarmPlayer.description: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable Minions that Attack and Poison enemies.
RavenousSwarmPlayer.name: Ravenous Swarm

ReapPlayer.description: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness. Cannot be Triggered.
ReapPlayer.name: Reap

SacrificePlayer.description: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.
SacrificePlayer.name: Sacrifice

ScatteringCalamityPlayer.description: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
ScatteringCalamityPlayer.name: His Scattering Calamity

ShatteringPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.
ShatteringPalmPlayer.name: Shattering Palm

SigilOfPowerPlayer.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
SigilOfPowerPlayer.name: Sigil of Power

SiphonElementsPlayer.description: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.
SiphonElementsPlayer.name: Siphon Elements

SiphoningStrikePlayer.description: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
SiphoningStrikePlayer.name: Siphoning Strike

SnapPlayer.description: Consume the elemental energy from a Frozen, Shocked or Ignited enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an Infusion Remnant. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same Ailment, but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.
SnapPlayer.name: Snap

SolarOrbPlayer.description: Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.
SolarOrbPlayer.name: Solar Orb

SoulOfferingPlayer.description: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
SoulOfferingPlayer.name: Soul Offering

SoulrendPlayer.description: Fire a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.
SoulrendPlayer.name: Soulrend

SparkPlayer.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.
SparkPlayer.name: Spark

StaggeringPalmPlayer.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, instantly Heavily Stunning enemies which are Primed for Stun and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Primed targets in range if your first target was Stunned. Heavy Stunning an enemy with this Skill grants you a Buff that causes your Quarterstaff Attacks to also fire Projectiles for a short duration. Heavy Stunning additional enemies adds to the Buff's duration.
StaggeringPalmPlayer.name: Staggering Palm

StormWavePlayer.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff, projecting a bolt of Lightning through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.
StormWavePlayer.name: Storm Wave

SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer.description: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.
SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer.name: Skeletal Arsonist Minion

SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer.description: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer.name: Skeletal Brute Minion

SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer.name: Skeletal Cleric Minion

SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.
SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer.name: Skeletal Frost Mage Minion

SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer.description: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage
SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer.name: Skeletal Reaver Minion

SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.
SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer.name: Skeletal Sniper Minion

SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.
SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer.name: Skeletal Storm Mage Minion

SummonSkeletalWarriorsPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.
SummonSkeletalWarriorsPlayer.name: Skeletal Warrior Minion

SummonSpectrePlayer.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.
SummonSpectrePlayer.name: Spectre: {0}

SummonSpiralingConspiracyPlayer.description: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the Presence of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can Command some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.
SummonSpiralingConspiracyPlayer.name: Spiraling Conspiracy

TempestBellPlayer.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
TempestBellPlayer.name: Tempest Bell

TempestFlurryPlayer.description: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.
TempestFlurryPlayer.name: Tempest Flurry

TemporalChainsPlayer.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
TemporalChainsPlayer.name: Temporal Chains

TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer.description: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.
TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer.name: Grisly Pyre

TrinityPlayer.description: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.
TrinityPlayer.name: Trinity

UnearthPlayer.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.
UnearthPlayer.name: Unearth

UniqueBreachLightningBoltPlayer.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.
UniqueBreachLightningBoltPlayer.name: Lightning Bolt

UnleashPlayer.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.
UnleashPlayer.name: Unleash

VaultingImpactPlayer.description: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
VaultingImpactPlayer.name: Vaulting Impact

VileDisruptionPlayer.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.
VileDisruptionPlayer.name: His Vile Intrusion

VolatileDeadPlayer.description: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.
VolatileDeadPlayer.name: Volatile Dead

VulnerabilityPlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay. making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.
VulnerabilityPlayer.name: Vulnerability

WaveOfFrostPlayer.description: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.
WaveOfFrostPlayer.name: Wave of Frost

WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer.description: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.
WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer.name: Chaos Bolt

WhirlingAssaultPlayer.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.
WhirlingAssaultPlayer.name: Whirling Assault

WitherPlayer.description: Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.
WitherPlayer.name: Wither

WitheringPresencePlayer.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.
WitheringPresencePlayer.name: Withering Presence
